ranked_hypotheses.candidate: Arena leaf-mutex serialization across driver + W workers (C1/C2/C3)
ranked_hypotheses.current_fact: ONE std::mutex guards every slot transition; 8-9 acquisitions/op; TP submit/mark/reap/release all nest into it from 1+W threads
ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: At w4 the L2-L1 increment is dominated by cross-core arena-mutex transfers (futex traffic) that collapse at w1 (2 threads)
ranked_hypotheses.why_plausible: explains workers-axis cliff + depth coupling (capacity==D); flat at d1 matches mutex cost being amortized differently
ranked_hypotheses.falsifying_experiment: TAX-0B: e1 cliff-cell replication on native + perf stat :u + /proc ctx counters at w1 vs w4; then capacity/lock-held-time ablation
ranked_hypotheses.semantic_risk: LOW for measurement; any sharding experiment later must preserve admission-transaction + terminal-winner + reap-order semantics

ranked_hypotheses.candidate: Per-terminal ready-domain notify_all + per-op reaper wake cadence (H-W2)
ranked_hypotheses.current_fact: signal_ready_progress = mtx + epoch++ + notify_ALL per record_terminal from each worker; reaper parks per wait_one
ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: w4 produces concurrent epoch bumps + wakes from 4 cores on one cv/mtx; w1 serializes terminals so one wake reaps a batch (aggregation exists at w1, absent at w4)
ranked_hypotheses.why_plausible: wakes are batch-capable at the protocol level but per-op in the code; reaper wake/park cycle per op amplifies context switches
ranked_hypotheses.falsifying_experiment: instrument ready-epoch advances + wait_one return sizes per op at w1 vs w4 (existing AsyncStats + internal-testing counters, read-only); /proc ctxt counters
ranked_hypotheses.semantic_risk: measurement-only: none; future aggregation must keep split-phase predicate protocol (AC-6)

ranked_hypotheses.current_fact: notify_one per submit; driver takes work_mtx_ per submit; workers take it per pop + per active--
ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: admission bursts of D=32 submits collide with W pops on work_mtx_
ranked_hypotheses.why_plausible: w4-only shape; but L1 has an analogous single mutex, so the DELTA must come from L2's extra acquisitions, weakening this as the primary
ranked_hypotheses.falsifying_experiment: w sweep {1,2,4} at fixed d32 + work-domain occupancy telemetry (dispatch_occupancy/high_water exist as AC-1a signals)

ranked_hypotheses.candidate: Flat per-op control-plane tax (registration path: G + registry + access_mtx_ + O(capacity) resolve_completion scan + 2 fiber context switches per await)
ranked_hypotheses.current_fact: await_completion does G lock + registry acquire + access_mtx_ + arena O(capacity) resolve scan + arena register + fiber suspend/resume
ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: this is the w-independent FLAT component of L2-L1 (~1.3-2.0 us/op historical); it cannot explain the w4 cliff but sets the floor

ranked_hypotheses.falsifying_experiment: EXP-0 capacity sweep at fixed D (vary C) + resolve_completion iteration-count telemetry; depth sweep at fixed total bytes

planned_experiments_design_only.name: Capacity invariance
planned_experiments_design_only.question: With active depth D held fixed, does unused request capacity C itself cost per-op time (UnusedCapacity -> Tax)?
mechanism_fact_bases: RequestArena::resolve_completion() performs an O(request_capacity) scan on every waiter registration (include/sluice/async/detail/request_arena.hpp:947-958)
UringAsyncBackend::find_live_router_cookie_() performs an O(request_capacity) scan per CQE (src/async/uring_backend.cpp:1095)
planned_experiments_design_only.hypothesis: per-op cost rises monotonically with C at fixed D via the two O(C) scans + slot-array cache footprint
planned_experiments_design_only.baseline: C==D cell of the same ladder, same session
planned_experiments_design_only.variable: request_capacity C in {8, 32, 128, 512} at fixed D=8
planned_experiments_design_only.arms: ThreadPool L2 rung (hits resolve_completion) AND Uring rung (hits find_live_router_cookie_); both real-liburing READY
planned_experiments_design_only.control: C==D; d1 low-capacity cell; L1 rung every session
planned_experiments_design_only.metrics: wall/op median + raw samples; AsyncStats; resolve/router scan iteration counters if exposed read-only
planned_experiments_design_only.expected_result_if_hypothesis_true: monotonic per-op increase with C at fixed D on at least one arm
planned_experiments_design_only.falsifier: flat cost vs C on BOTH arms -> both O(C) paths demoted for this geometry; hypothesis-4 flat-tax component re-attributed
planned_experiments_design_only.does_not_prove: no wall-clock share attribution (that is EXP-2); no workers-axis claim
planned_experiments_design_only.bench_side_change_required: e1 bench currently constructs ThreadPoolBackend(request_capacity == depth) (bench/e1_abstraction_tax_bench.cpp:619-624); decoupling C from D is a bench-side parameter change, not production code
planned_experiments_design_only.environment_requirements: Release build; same CPU-placement preregistration as EXP-1
planned_experiments_design_only.semantic_safety: bench-parameter sweep only; zero production changes

planned_experiments_design_only.baseline: e1 ladder L0/L1/L2 on native, commit 5537187, Release clang, 1 GiB/cell, >=7 reps, file on btrfs /home + tmpfs /tmp control arm
planned_experiments_design_only.variable: workers {1,4} x depth {8,32,64} at 4 KiB (write AND read)
planned_experiments_design_only.control: d1 cells; L1 rung in every session (same-session A/B per docs/verification/performance-engineering.md)

planned_experiments_design_only.name: Uring dispatch/backlog profile
planned_experiments_design_only.question: Do the single-driver serialization (dispatch_mtx_ across the kernel submit_and_wait park), the per-dispatch remove_exact O(queue) shift (drain of N = O(N^2) handle moves), and the per-CQE router scan dominate uring per-op cost at high backlog?
planned_experiments_design_only.hypothesis: per-op cost is non-flat in backlog because dispatch batch boundaries and the O(N^2) drain shape the driver loop
planned_experiments_design_only.baseline: d1 low-backlog cell; ThreadPool rung at same geometry
planned_experiments_design_only.variable: depth/backlog {8, 32, 64} at scheduler workers=1, single Fiber; request_capacity fixed
planned_experiments_design_only.metrics: wall/op; submit_flushes_ / live_cookies_ telemetry; dispatch-queue high-water via uring test seams (read-only); user-mode perf on the driver thread
planned_experiments_design_only.expected_result_if_hypothesis_true: non-flat cost vs backlog correlated with flush count / queue high-water
planned_experiments_design_only.falsifier: flat vs backlog with constant flush counts -> dispatch/backlog hypothesis demoted; focus shifts to capacity mechanism (EXP-0)
planned_experiments_design_only.environment_requirements: real-liburing (READY); same CPU-placement preregistration as EXP-1
planned_experiments_design_only.semantic_safety: zero production changes; test seams read-only
